subject: rc
title: RC------AFL.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-29 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's clarification: 'the perceived composite western affinity alignment is not the composite western affinity alignment … there would still be the realness of affinity dynamics as well as the dynamic uniqueness of given planet areas and/or vibrational groups.' (C)RC (the concept of race) is crossed with AFL (affinity alignment): the question is what race produces when crossed with affinity-alignment — race being explicitly held at the conceptual level (the (c) prefix). INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) branches from the main line and carries IF-SPT (infra-spirituality) and IST-F (isolated focus). AFL is the partner. AFTD (affinity tendencies) also branches from the main line and leads to AF-POST (affinity postulation), then to COS-D (cosmic dictates) and on to HI-P (high purpose).
